# Excel

Microsoft Excel is a powerful spreadsheet application for data analysis, calculations, and visualization, enabling users to organize and process data with formulas, charts, and pivot tables

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/excel/.

## Actions

- **Add Table**: Create a table in a workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **Add Workbook Permission**: Grant access to a workbook via invite.
- **Create Excel Session**: Create a session for an excel workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **Insert Range**: Insert a new cell range into a worksheet, shifting existing cells down or right.
- **List Table Columns** (read-only): List columns in a table using microsoft graph api.
- **Add Chart**: Add a chart to a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **Add SharePoint Worksheet**: Add a new worksheet to a sharepoint excel workbook using microsoft graph sites api.
- **Add Table Column**: Add a column to a table using microsoft graph api.
- **Add Table Row**: Add a row to a table using microsoft graph api.
- **Add Worksheet**: Add a new worksheet to an excel workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **Apply Table Filter**: Apply a filter to a table column using microsoft graph api.
- **Apply Table Sort**: Apply a sort to a table using microsoft graph api.
- **Clear Range**: Clear values, formats, or contents in a specified worksheet range.
- **Clear Table Filter**: Clear a filter from a table column using microsoft graph api.
- **Close Excel Session**: Close an existing excel workbook session.
- **Convert Table To Range**: Convert a table to a range using microsoft graph api.
- **Create Workbook**: Create a new workbook file at a specified drive path.
- **Delete Table Column**: Delete a column from a table using microsoft graph api.
- **Delete Table Row**: Delete a row from a table using microsoft graph api.
- **Delete Worksheet**: Delete a worksheet from the workbook.
- **Get Chart Axis** (read-only): Retrieve a specific axis from a chart.
- **Get Chart Data Labels** (read-only): Retrieve the data labels object of a chart.
- **Get Chart Legend** (read-only): Retrieve the legend object of a chart.
- **Get Range** (read-only): Get a range from a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **Get SharePoint Range** (read-only): Get a range from a worksheet in sharepoint using microsoft graph sites api.
- **Get SharePoint Worksheet** (read-only): Get a worksheet by name or id from a sharepoint excel workbook using microsoft graph sites api.
- **Get Table Column** (read-only): Retrieve a specific column from a workbook table.
- **Get workbook** (read-only): Retrieve the properties and relationships of a workbook.
- **Get Worksheet** (read-only): Get a worksheet by name or id from an excel workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **List Chart Series** (read-only): List all data series in a chart.
- **List Charts** (read-only): List charts in a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **List Comments** (read-only): List comments in an excel workbook.
- **List Drive Files** (read-only): List files and folders in a drive root or specified path.
- **List Named Items** (read-only): List named items in a workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **List SharePoint Tables** (read-only): List tables in a sharepoint worksheet using microsoft graph sites api.
- **List SharePoint Worksheets** (read-only): List worksheets in an excel workbook stored in sharepoint using microsoft graph sites api.
- **List Table Rows** (read-only): List rows in a table using microsoft graph api.
- **List Tables** (read-only): List tables in a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **List Workbook Permissions** (read-only): List permissions set on the workbook file.
- **List Worksheets** (read-only): List worksheets in an excel workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **Merge Cells**: Merge cells in a worksheet range using microsoft graph api.
- **Protect Worksheet**: Protect a worksheet using optional protection options.
- **Sort Range**: Sort a range in a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **Update Chart**: Update a chart in a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **Update Chart Legend**: Update formatting or position of a chart legend.
- **Update Range**: Update a range in a worksheet using microsoft graph api.
- **Update SharePoint Range**: Update a range in a sharepoint worksheet using microsoft graph sites api.
- **Update Table**: Update a table in a workbook using microsoft graph api.
- **Update Worksheet**: Update worksheet properties (name, position) in an excel workbook using microsoft graph api.
